codeFindings.claim: Catalog: 'P11: restart — persisted index (fast) or re-derived?' — presented as a measured answer.
codeFindings.reality: p11_restart hardcodes restart_fast=False and the 're-derived state (no persisted index)' evidence without comparing restart timing to the cold start; the constant happens to be true for the shim, pyright, and lean, but it is asserted, not measured.

codeFindings.claim: did_change implements LSP textDocument/didChange document versioning.
codeFindings.reality: did_change always stamps version 2, so the second change on the same document (P2's restore) re-sends version 2 — LSP requires monotonically increasing versions. Internally consistent (the battery's waits filter on version in (None, 2)) and tolerated by the shim, pyright, and lean, but spec-nonconforming for any server that enforces monotonic versions.
